release_notes:
Fix: skip license check entirely for unencrypted installs

license_guard.php was enforcing license.json on every client page load
with no exemption for unencrypted (non-bolt) installs, breaking any
install that predates the check or never needed one -- including our
own xpertsgsm.com/xpertunlock.com production sites and local dev.
Licensing only makes sense for the encrypted distribution customers
receive; mirrors the same bolt_decrypt() guard db_c_n_f_g.php already
uses for its own license fetch.
